capabilities: Turn words wrapped in a delimiter into inline speaker buttons
Speak selected text via context menu, command, or mobile toolbar
Read all marked words in a note in sequence
Replay the same text at a configurable slow rate
Switch the active language from the status bar or set it per note in frontmatter
extras: Does not work on Android at all (window.speechSynthesis is missing from the Android WebView Obsidian uses); on iOS only Compact-tier voices are reachable. Voice quality depends on voices installed in the OS. Installable via BRAT for beta testing; README says it is not yet published in the Community Plugins browser.
intentEvidence: Existing TTS plugins (Apple TTS, Text to Speech, ...) are built to read whole notes aloud
problem: Existing TTS plugins read whole notes aloud, often depend on desktop-only system binaries, and don't offer quick per-word pronunciation on mobile.
